scope: Test-only closed historical fixtures for lifecycle applicability, checkpoint recovery and backlog review. Positive controls execute exact fe4 application/data sources with unchanged b12 tool guards. Current C2 sources remain explicitly rejected. No current runtime, native, financial, migration, deployment or onchain qualification is transferred.

helper.owner: Separately reviewed shared test fixture launcher

fixtureIntegration.originalPositiveAssertions: Preserved; each complete existing body executes in a fresh checked cold child.
fixtureIntegration.executingInputs: Historical src/data module and guard-read bytes are served from the same strictly bound Git profile; imported changed values are not taken from current modules.
fixtureIntegration.backlogSourceRevision: Explicit historical fixture revision, replacing HEAD only in this test fixture; no Git interception.
fixtureIntegration.currentRefusals: Each parent verifies exact C2 revision→blob→canonical SHA before LF, CRLF and tampered-source rejection by its unchanged guard.
fixtureIntegration.backlogReadControl: Only the exact diplomacy URL read is replaced for each negative case; fs.readFileSync is restored in finally, and one actual guard read is required per case.
fixtureIntegration.databaseAndNetwork: Each of ten cold fixtures completed with zero database/network attempts; no native or retained fixture flags supplied.
